title: Time bound for the counter loop
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be an input word, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$, and let $\tau$ assign a natural-number time bound to each such configuration. For a Boolean word $w$ whose binary value is $d$, and a natural number $B$ such that $\tau$ is at most $B$ on each configuration reached after $r$ counter-loop rounds for every $r<d$, the sum of these $d$ time bounds plus the counter overhead of $w$ through round $d$ is at most $dB+4d+2|w|+2$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes and a multi-tape Turing machine over arbitrary symbol and state types
An input word and a configuration of the machine on that input
A time-bound function from configurations to natural numbers
A Boolean word and a natural number $d$ equal to its binary value
For every $r<d$, the time bound on the configuration after $r$ counter-loop rounds is at most $B$
